prerequisites: For English, French, Spanish, Polish, and Russian, participation in placement tests/interviews is required for course admission. Admission is decided by the ZfS (Center for Language Teaching).

learning_outcomes.text: Students acquire (or deepen) competencies in a foreign language.
They train their listening and reading comprehension and practice speaking orally, participating in conversations, and writing texts (of varying difficulty).
They expand their vocabulary and learn to apply grammar rules correctly.
Depending on the level of the chosen course, they are able to handle communication situations of varying complexity.
They also learn strategies that enable them to further develop their language competence independently.
In some courses, the focus is on individual sub-competencies (e.g., Writing Skills for Engineering Students, Speaking in Academic Contexts, Conversación para avanzados).

syllabus_topics: Content of one course from the Center for Language Teaching (ZfS) of the University of Paderborn, equivalent to 3 ECTS.

assessment_methods.method: Written exam or oral exam (Klausur oder mündliche Prüfung)

assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon passing the module final examination. The module is weighted by its ECTS credit points (factor: 1).
